overloads.semanticRole: The Pop up menu command displays a pop-up menu at the current location of the mouse.

jointConstraints.rule: xCoord and yCoord must be passed together (both or neither); they are nested as a pair after default in the doc syntax, not independently optional.

constraints: Should usually be called in response to a mouse click while the mouse button is still down, to follow standard UI conventions.

contents syntax: items separated by ';'; '(' prefix disables an item; '-' or '(-' inserts a separator line; a leading '<' plus a style letter (B/I/U/O/S) sets font style for the item; a leading '!' plus a character adds a check mark; a leading '^' plus an icon reference adds an icon.
